verse1: I have waited in the silence
I have wondered where You are
But the night has never hidden
Who You have been from the start
preChorus: When I cannot see the answer
I will hold on to Your word
chorus: Through the waiting, through the hurting
I will trust the hands I cannot see
And You're not finished with me
verse2: You are shaping what is broken
With a patience I can't comprehend
bridge: I will not call the silence empty
I will not call the waiting waste
You have carried me through every chapter
And I will trust Your heart again
finalChorus: Through the waiting, through the hurting
I will trust the hands I cannot see
And You're not finished with me

musicDirection.keySuggestion: D major / B minor emotional palette
arrangement: verse: piano, subtle ambient guitar texture
chorus: full piano, pads, restrained drums, cinematic strings
bridge: strip back to piano then build
final chorus: widest cinematic arrangement, no excessive choir
musicDirection.requirement: Original melody and instrumental. Do not imitate a specific living artist or existing worship song.

lyricVideo.visualStyle: professional realistic moving video, not still-image slideshow
scenes: night road / city lights in rain
wide sunrise landscape for final chorus
lyricVideo.textStyle: one or two lyric lines at a time; premium serif/sans pairing; mobile safe margins; phrase-level sync
lyricVideo.motion: real footage throughout with slow cinematic cuts and occasional speed ramps

theologyGuard.notes: Lyrics are inspired by Philippians 1:6 and present trust/formation without promising a specific material outcome.
